title: Likely Values of Dispersion Numbers D/UL at Different Length –Width Ratios
rows: Length to width ratio 8:1 or more
Two or Three cells in series
markdown:
| Aerated Lagoon | Approximate range of D/UL values | Typical mixing condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length to width ratio 1:1 to 4:1 | 3.0 to 4.0 and over | Well mixed |
| Length to width ratio 8:1 or more | 0.2 - 0.6 | Approaching plug flow |
| Two or Three cells in series | 0.2 – 0.6 (overall) | - do- |
notes: Title is printed with a space before the en dash in "Length –Width".
The third row prints "- do-" meaning the same mixing condition as the row above; preserved verbatim.
